episodes.title: Motion in a Straight Line
episodes.description: Describe straight-line motion using displacement, velocity, time, and acceleration.

episodes.title: Derivatives
episodes.description: See how derivatives provide a mathematical language for describing physical changes.

episodes.title: Integrals
episodes.description: Use integration and known motion information to work out distances and positions.

episodes.title: Vectors and 2D Motion
episodes.description: Distinguish scalar and vector quantities while describing motion in two dimensions.

episodes.title: Newton’s Laws
episodes.description: Explore Newton's laws and their role in explaining everyday motion and interactions.

episodes.title: Friction
episodes.description: Compare the friction that resists starting motion with the friction acting during sliding.

episodes.title: Uniform Circular Motion
episodes.description: Distinguish centripetal effects from apparent centrifugal forces in circular motion.

episodes.title: Newtonian Gravity
episodes.description: Explore Newton's account of gravitation and reconsider the familiar falling-apple story.

episodes.title: Work, Energy, and Power
episodes.description: Learn how physicists define work and connect it with energy and power.

episodes.title: Collisions
episodes.description: Examine how mass and momentum shape what happens when objects collide.

episodes.title: Rotational Motion
episodes.description: Explore rotation and why the motion of a wheel's individual points depends on perspective.

episodes.title: Torque
episodes.description: Connect torque with rotational behavior and the distribution of an object's mass.

episodes.title: Statics
episodes.description: Investigate nonaccelerating structures through stretching, compression, and spring forces.

episodes.title: Fluids at Rest
episodes.description: Introduce the properties of fluids and why they matter in physics and engineering.

episodes.title: Fluids in Motion
episodes.description: Explore how pressure differences affect moving fluids and the forces they can produce.

episodes.title: Simple Harmonic Motion
episodes.description: Use the Millennium Bridge's engineering problems to investigate repeating oscillations.

episodes.title: Traveling Waves
episodes.description: See how traveling disturbances carry energy through ropes and other physical systems.

episodes.title: Sound
episodes.description: Explore sound transmission and the change in perceived frequency associated with motion.

episodes.title: The Physics of Music
episodes.description: Connect musical sounds with vibrating waves and the way our ears respond.

episodes.title: Temperature
episodes.description: Examine thermal expansion and the ideal gas relationship through practical engineering examples.

episodes.title: Kinetic Theory and Phase Changes
episodes.description: Explore kinetic theory, changing phases, and how scientists establish reference levels on other planets.

episodes.title: The Physics of Heat
episodes.description: Investigate heat transfer and why clothing can help retain body warmth.

episodes.title: Thermodynamics
episodes.description: Connect thermodynamic laws and entropy with the limits on perpetual-motion machines.

episodes.title: Engines
episodes.description: Explore engine operation, practical usefulness, and the factors that determine efficiency.

episodes.title: Electric Charge
episodes.description: Investigate electric charges, their interactions, and Coulomb's mathematical account of electrostatic force.

episodes.title: Electric Fields
episodes.description: Describe charged objects using electric fields, field lines, conductors, and capacitors.

episodes.title: Voltage, Electric Energy, and Capacitors
episodes.description: Connect voltage and electrical potential energy with capacitors and stored energy.

episodes.title: Electric Current
episodes.description: Explore flowing charge and the role of voltaic cells in producing electric current.

episodes.title: DC Resistors & Batteries
episodes.description: Examine real batteries, internal resistance, and voltage and current in circuit arrangements.

episodes.title: Circuit Analysis
episodes.description: Compare series and parallel connections through an analysis of familiar lighting circuits.

episodes.title: Capacitors and Kirchhoff
episodes.description: Analyze direct-current networks containing multiple batteries, junctions, loops, and capacitors.

episodes.title: Magnetism
episodes.description: Explore magnetic poles, magnetic materials, and the field surrounding Earth.

episodes.title: Ampère’s Law
episodes.description: Follow Ampère's investigation of how electric currents generate magnetic fields.

episodes.title: Induction – An Introduction
episodes.description: Introduce electromagnetic induction and the relationship between magnetic effects and electricity.

episodes.title: How Power Gets to Your Home
episodes.description: Trace the physical processes that deliver electrical power into homes.

episodes.title: AC Circuits
episodes.description: Explore alternating-current circuits and their role in transmitting electricity over long distances.

episodes.title: Maxwell’s Equations
episodes.description: Connect Faraday's discoveries with Maxwell's mathematical description of electricity and magnetism.

episodes.title: Geometric Optics
episodes.description: Examine how light travels and how its paths can be understood geometrically.

episodes.title: Light Is Waves
episodes.description: Explore evidence that light behaves as a wave and what that explains.

episodes.title: Spectra Interference
episodes.description: Investigate what changing, reflecting, and refracting light can reveal about its sources.

episodes.title: Optical Instruments
episodes.description: Learn how lenses and other optical devices form images and produce magnification.

episodes.title: Special Relativity
episodes.description: Explore how observation, motion, and light challenge everyday intuitions about relativity.

episodes.title: Quantum Mechanics – Part 1
episodes.description: Introduce quantum theory through light's wave-particle behavior and the ultraviolet problem.

episodes.title: Quantum Mechanics – Part 2
episodes.description: Continue exploring quantum mechanics through probability, energy, and the famous boxed-cat thought experiment.

episodes.title: Nuclear Physics
episodes.description: Explore nuclear physics and the physical meaning of Einstein's mass-energy relationship.

episodes.title: Astrophysics and Cosmology
episodes.description: Apply astrophysics and cosmology to understanding space and the universe as a whole.
